splinter.function_search_path_mutable_public_may_: Unpinned on purpose: a SET clause stops the planner inlining it, and list_proposer_names() calls it once per proposal, four times slower pinned. SECURITY INVOKER, every function it calls schema-qualified; 0176 records the reason in its COMMENT.

plpgsql_check.replay_policy(regclass,name,text,text) |: EXECUTEs the CREATE POLICY a migration file states, which is its purpose (0001, section 3c). Executable by no API role; db-init calls it as the owner.
plpgsql_check.replay_trigger(regclass,name,text,text): EXECUTEs the CREATE TRIGGER a migration file states, which is its purpose (0001, section 3c). Executable by no API role; db-init calls it as the owner.
plpgsql_check.active_schema_version(uuid) | warning ex: The LOOP exits only by RETURN or RAISE; the end is unreachable.
plpgsql_check.capped_capture_manifest(jsonb) | warning: Marked IMMUTABLE and calls to_jsonb(), which is STABLE. Harmless for its integer argument; relabel STABLE when the function is next touched.

historian_splinter.function_search_path_mutable_public_refr: A job procedure that commits between refreshes: a SET clause would make it atomic, and refresh_continuous_aggregate() refuses to run there (timescaledb/README.md). Every name in the body is schema-qualified, and it runs as the superuser who owns it.
historian_splinter.extension_in_public_timescaledb: TimescaleDB installs itself in public, and the historian is not exposed through PostgREST, which is what this lint guards.
